pre_registration.opening: In this six-chapter first arc, complete Wren's arrival, aptitude assessment, acquisition of starter Loadstitch and crossing to drinking water within Chapter 1. Preserve her wrong judgment of unfamiliar timber and the change in her assessment method; the remaining ordinary joints can pass in summary. Her first cast serves the crossing. Ordinary bearing carries her weight, the dried seam resists sideways slip within its starter limits, and she offers the companion a way across. Give the relief of drinking and the freely offered verdict chit room to begin their relationship. Develop the consequences of reaching water in the later chapters rather than staging the crossing again. Keep the memorial pursuit, Sill's competing interests, the early Load choice, the Ossik repair relationship and the unresolved false-condemnation mystery within the six-chapter arc.
pre_registration.consequence: Wren spends her first advancement Point on Load instead of Duration. Before she can acquire Duration, a bedding attempt fails because the sixty-second hold ends too soon: that batch of paste is spent, the member remains uninstalled and the affected route remains closed. She carries this unfinished repair and her unfulfilled bargain with the crew through the end of that chapter. A qualifying test and the Duration purchase come in a later chapter, after she has had to act with that failure still unresolved. The new test's required load fits the starter allowance of one hundred newtons; buying Load was not its prerequisite. Completing the permanent repair requires fresh paste and renewed cooperation from workers with their own interests. The later gain helps her undertake that work but does not recover the spent material or lost working time. She retains the Load capability. Ordinary bearing and cured bedding make the eventual repair permanent; the spell remains temporary. Preserve the actual measurement, novelty and resource rules throughout.
